question: Where is the nearest gallery you pass when going from DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel, Bedford, MA to Swan Boats, Boston, MA?
sql: SELECT pois.poi_name, pois.addr_city, pois.addr_state FROM pois WHERE pois.tourism = 'gallery' AND ST_Intersects( pois.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Bedford%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Swan Boats%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Boston%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1) )::geography, 100 -- Buffer of 100 meters around the path ) ) ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Bedford%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1;
